description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bandiyamulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511810
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in Gampaha District under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, owner information, extent measurements, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
